integrity.source_difference: Static capture adds explicit output_attentions=False; archived real capture omitted it. All other capture AST is identical after removing this explicit False keyword.

definitions.normalization: Activation squared per hidden coordinate and time point, without total-energy normalization.
definitions.numerical_floor: max(1e-20,total_energy*1e-12); numerical sensitivity only, not significance.
definitions.rfft: T=8; orthonormal one-sided FFT, weights [1,2,2,2,1]; four non-DC bins.
definitions.static_construction: One actual first/last input RGB frame repeated 16 times; original presentation timestamps and prompt retained.

spatial_availability.future_local_extraction: A future separately authorized capture could save [T,P,D] before mean(dim=1), then use audited processor patch-merging/grid order for P-to-space mapping. These archives cannot provide that tensor, and spatial token index is not an object track.

limitations: Static RGB content lacks input visual motion but retains timestamps, positions and causal context; nonzero hidden temporal energy cannot be attributed purely to visual motion.
This comparison does not isolate timestamps, positional encoding, contextual accumulation, vision mixing or numerical effects from one another.
Real-minus-static is not a unique motion component: the model is nonlinear and the content/trajectory itself changes.
DC is not identified as background/noise; temporal energy is not identified as task-relevant information.
Spatial pooling can hide local differences; stored moments cannot recover local temporal spectra.
Only 8 reused development videos and 8 hidden time samples; medians/ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
No QA labels or task utility are measured in static controls.
These results do not explain the prior layer-0 selector failure and do not repair prior spectral-memory negative results.
